title: Unnamed Titan 010
summary: Unnamed Titan 010 has the appearance of a towering golem entirely built from large stone monoliths, covered in Egyptian hieroglyphics. It the first to enter hostile terrain and smash through a path of its Seeker like a living battering ram. Its Amulet is in the possession of Grier.

'''Unnamed Titan 010''' has the appearance of a towering golem entirely built from large stone monoliths, covered in Egyptian hieroglyphics. It the first to enter hostile terrain and smash through a path of its Seeker like a living battering ram. Its Amulet is in the possession of [[Grier]]. 

== History ==
[[Grier]] used this Titan to clear the area of stone obelisks for him and his men to advance. {{Source|TCG:SAS-135|SAS-135}}

== Abilities ==
This Titan's towering height and large stride make it ideal for scouting dangerous areas and clearing obstacles from its path. Its stone body makes it durable and resistant to damage. {{Source|TCG:SAS-135|SAS-135}}
